page_title: WOL 1-2 EIN | Wolfsburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+7' 1 - 2 Goal! Adam Daghim clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box low into the middle of the net. Michael Zetterer had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
90+7' A quickly taken corner by Wolfsburg.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 26132.
90+2' Substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo makes his way off the pitch and Love Arrhov (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as his replacement.
90+1' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
88' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
86' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Zehnter trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
85' It will be a substitution. Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Oscar Hojlund walks off.
85' Albert Riera decides to make a substitution. Fares Chaibi will be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Jonathan Burkardt cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Michael Zetterer.
82' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

82' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolfsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
79' Denis Vavro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg).
78' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

77' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
73' Substitution. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) replaces Christian Eriksen.
73' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Patrick Wimmer and he is replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
73' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
71' Substitution. Ayoube Amaimouni is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
69' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
67' The referee is firm and issues Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) a deserved yellow card.
67' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
66' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
63' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Michael Zetterer.
60' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
59' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) picks up a yellow card.
57' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

57' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
56' Flag goes up against Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
53' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.

49' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Wolfsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

47' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
46' The game is over for Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg). Lovro Majer comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a strong challenge and Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner kick.
44' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt).
43' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Eintracht Frankfurt work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

40' A lofted cross from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
37' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
32' 0 - 2 Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Jonathan Burkardt shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:2.

32' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Kamil Grabara makes a nice save.
30' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his low, long-range blast aimed directly at the bottom of the net.
25' Eintracht Frankfurt keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

21' 0 - 1 Ayoube Amaimouni looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the left post. The score is 0:1.

13' Michael Zetterer pulls off a great save to deny Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

3' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Timo Gerach was nominated as the referee for this game.
